Criteria for Approval:
• Diagnosis of severe irritable bowel syndrome with diarrhea (IBS-D); AND
• Patient is female; AND
• Trial and failure of the specified length of, contraindication or intolerance to, ≥ 3 agents among the following drug classes (used separately or in combination):
○ Antidiarrheals (e.g., diphenoxylate/atropine, loperamide) for ≥ 1 month
○ Bile acid sequestrants for ≥ 1 month
○ Antispasmodics (e.g., dicyclomine, hyoscyamine) for ≥ 1 month.

Age Limit: ≥ 18 years
Quantity Limit: 2 per day
